name: Qwen3 Technical Report (arXiv:2505.09388)
notes: Primary source for the Qwen3 dense and MoE families. Confirms dense GQA (no MLA) across the whole Qwen3 line, the 235B-A22B / 30B-A3B split with 8 activated experts per token, and the hybrid thinking / non-thinking serving modes as a mode switch rather than a separate architecture.
